text:
# Close wrap — Tue 2026-11-24 (~4:26 PM ET)

**Indexes:** S&P 500 −0.50% to 7,201.10; Nasdaq −1.48% to 23,733.54; Dow +424.46 (+0.86%) to 50,019.77, its first close above 50k ([ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/24/wall-street-chiude-contrastata-nvidia-perde-il-7-giu-nasdaq-e-s500_f180435a-026b-4843-af5b-f1ccf24fb030.html), [ChainCatcher](https://www.chaincatcher.com/en/article/2307754)). The AI trade cooled after Monday's best day since Apr 2025. NVDA fell ~6–7%, and AMD, MU and AVGO also slid; Dec hike odds are ~95% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-24-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-chip-stocks-nvidia-140629923.html)). Tech was ~−3.3%, while health care (~+3.0%) and staples (~+1.7%) led ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-earnings-oil-feec0e25b9994b1c86b16329cf770192)). NBIS fell ~−10% and IREN ~−13% (X news). Gold dropped ~3%.
**Macro:** Conference Board confidence rose 11.4 pts to 103.3, the highest since Jan 2025 ([PRN](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/us-consumer-confidence-surged-in-november-302949447.html)).
**Covered:** DLTR C $155.20 (+12.5%; O $148.06), so the gap held ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/DLTR)). BBY C $99.62 (+2.7%; O $99.22) ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BBY/history/)). A C $183.53 (+4.3%) but below its $186.96 open ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/A/history/)).
**After hours:** DELL rev $54.9B, non-GAAP EPS $9.45 vs ~$6.55 est; FY27 rev guide $202B ([BW](https://www.businesswire.com/newsDell-Technologies-Delivers-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Financial-Results ~$299 AH (+~3%) ([Public](https://public.com/stocks/dell/after-hours)). HPQ non-GAAP EPS $0.83, rev $16.0B, div hike ([GNW](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/24/3409888/0/en/hp-inc-reports-fiscal-2026-full-year-and-fourth-quarter-results-announces-dividend-increase.html)); AH choppy. WDAY beat ($2.82/$2.71B) but −2.8% AH ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/workday-shares-fall-28-in-choppy-trading-after-thirdquarter-earnings-beat-5049010)). ADSK beat ($3.20/$2.16B) ([EarningsToday](https://www.earningstoday.com/earnings-calendar/daily/2026-11-24)).
**Tomorrow:** PCE, GDP, durables and claims at 8:30; DE BMO; Beige Book at 2:00. Thu closed, Fri half day. AI-hardware avoid review at 11/25 close (DELL/HPQ now out).

## Swing ideas (conditionals resolved)
- **DLTR** long, logged at C $155.20. Traffic-led beat and raise, gap held all day. Conf: low. Risk: ~$0.65 of the raise is tariff refunds; extended after +12.5%.
- **BBY** long, logged at C $99.62. Comps +6.1%, FY raise, closed green from the open. Conf: low. Risk: hot PCE / hike tape; consumer electronics softness.
- A: void (faded from the open; lesson 10/23).
